recommendation_summary: The reply recommends acting now on a review coverage rule inside the current team and tracker: give each PR an available, authorized reviewer (the lead stays eligible but is no longer the default sole reviewer), name a qualified backup who takes over at once if the assigned reviewer is absent, and review within the same working day. It applies the rule to waiting and new PRs this week and measures approval wait time against the three-day baseline. It makes no optional additions, and it removes the reorganization, Jira Align and workshops from this launch.
